what_this_is: The Workshop row for tools/run-on-a-persons-computer's script runner: a model's script runs in the script sandbox (script-sandbox.mjs) inside its OS wall (confined-run.mjs, the read-only tier), with the pinned Node below as its program. The engine fetches that Node, checks the archive's BLAKE3 against the pin, unpacks it and runs it from its own folder (the same road as audio-transcription's python3 pin). The runner (run-a-script.mjs, mapped in computer/mac-tools.json) takes the script and its input, runs it through the script sandbox (script-sandbox.mjs), and answers each call(toolId, input) as the person, through one door call with the account's key.

payload.label: Run a script over my tools
payload.job: Run a JavaScript body that calls my Workshop tools with call(toolId, input) inside a sandbox with no files and no network, and return only the value it returns
payload.description: A model's script runs in a child process started through confined-run (read-only tier: no writes, no network) from the pinned Node, with node --permission inside. The script reaches the Workshop only through call(toolId, input), which the host answers as the person.

code.description: A function body; `return` the value to answer with.

output_schema.description: The value the script returned, bounded by the script sandbox's result_chars.

macos-x86_64.unverified: No pinned download yet: the darwin-x64 archive of Node 25.3.0 was not downloaded or checked when this row was written.
